headline: Eversource Gas petition to install and replace underground gas lines in the McKnight Neighborhood.
summary: Eversource Gas asks to install and replace underground gas facilities at Vassar St., Harvard Street, Yale Street, Lafayette St and Princeton Street. The petition also asks to retire aged cast iron low pressure natural gas lines.
items: Eversource Gas petition to install and replace underground gas facilities in the McKnight Neighborhood and retire aged cast iron gas lines (Vassar Street)
location: At the corner of Harvard Street and St James Ave.
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 4/22/2025 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can be acted 
upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Tuesday, December 8, 2026 at 3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
At the corner of Harvard Street and St James Ave. 
 
Petitions 
To install and replace underground gas facilities within a section of the McKnight Neighborhood 
at Vassar St., Harvard Street, Yale Street, Lafayette St and Princeton Street and retire the aged 
cast iron low pressure natural gas infrastructure. 
 1. EVERSOURCE GAS - Vassar Street
